relationship_to_dataset_v1: Dataset V1 is preserved unchanged as immutable historical evidence. V2 does not replace or rewrite it.

acquisition.note: Freqtrade timeranges are start-inclusive and end-exclusive, so 20260901 is the exclusive bound for a window ending 2026-08-31.

warmup.purpose: Indicator warm-up only. Never scored, never optimised against. One month of 1h candles is ~744 bars, comfortably more than the 200 an EMA200 needs, so no Development bar is computed from a partially warmed indicator.

development.purpose: Four years. The only window BASELINE-1 may be examined on before its logic is frozen.

validation.status: closed until the baseline implementation and Development protocol are frozen
validation.purpose: Twenty months. Run once, unchanged, after the freeze. Not a pristine holdout - see locked_oos below.

locked_oos.reason: No period of this dataset qualifies as pristine Locked OOS. Dataset V1 work already inspected 2025-09 through 2026-09 (its development, validation and OOS windows all fall inside 2025-2026), so designating any 2025-2026 span as untouched holdout would be false. The Validation window here is therefore labelled Validation, not OOS.
locked_oos.first_strict_prospective_holdout: forward paper / prospective OOS, beginning only after the strategy and protocol are frozen, over data that did not exist at freeze time

fee_assumption.source: Binance spot taker fee, 0.1% per side, set explicitly in the config rather than inherited from an exchange default
fee_assumption.slippage_note: no slippage model applied; entry and exit use the configured order-book pricing

integrity_contract.canonical_digest_definition: sha256 over the version tag followed by one line per candle, candles sorted by timestamp, each line 'ts|open|high|low|close|volume' with integer milliseconds and Python's shortest round-tripping float repr
integrity_contract.why: A Feather/PyArrow version bump, a compression change or different file metadata moves the raw file hash while the market data is identical. The canonical digest is the drift signal; the raw hash is recorded but a mismatch with a matching canonical digest is a serialization note, not drift.

acquisition_route.environment: The cloud sandbox cannot reach Binance: the egress policy answers 403 to CONNECT for api.binance.com, data-api.binance.vision, api1.binance.com and fapi.binance.com.
acquisition_route.route: GitHub Actions runner via .github/workflows/dataset-v2.yml, using the pinned freqtradeorg/freqtrade image. Evidence returns as workflow artifacts and is committed here.
acquisition_route.command: freqtrade download-data --exchange binance --pairs BTC/USDT ETH/USDT --timeframes 5m 1h --timerange 20201201-20260901 --data-format-ohlcv feather
